title: Marine mammal call classification with random forest and transformer models on 4,761 Watkins recordings
description: Classification of nine Arctic and subarctic marine mammal species and three taxonomic groups from 4,761 recordings of the Watkins Marine Mammal Sound Database, comparing a random forest on 90 acoustic features with a transformer trained from scratch on log mel spectrograms. All models are evaluated with 5 fold cross validation grouped by recording session, and the same models are also scored with random splits to measure how much leakage between clips from the same recording tape inflates accuracy.
